title: Parker Solar Probe by the Numbers: The Fastest Thing Humans Ever Built
description:
Parker Solar Probe passed the Sun at about 692,000 km/h and about 6.1 million km from its surface.

Images: NASA. Narration and graphics were generated with AI. Figures are from public sources and rounded.

#space #nasa #sun #shorts

scenes.vo: The fastest object humans have ever built is a probe that flies into the Sun's atmosphere.
scenes.label: top speed

scenes.vo: At its closest, it passed just six point one million kilometers from the solar surface.
scenes.label: closest approach

scenes.vo: Its heat shield, only eleven centimeters thick, faces temperatures near one thousand four hundred degrees Celsius.
scenes.label: outside the heat shield
scenes.sub: Yet the instruments stay near room temperature

scenes.vo: Follow for more of the numbers behind the Sun.
